function.name: impl_from_IEnumUnknown
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface of the object_enumerator structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the containing record is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: struct object_enumerator*, represents the containing record of the given interface.

function.name: object_enumerator_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches with the known ones (IID_IEnumUnknown or IID_IUnknown). If it matches, it increases the reference count of the interface and returns a pointer to it. If it doesn't match, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE if it's not.

function.name: object_enumerator_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the object_enumerator structure and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IEnumUnknown interface from which the object_enumerator structure is derived.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the object_enumerator structure.

function.name: object_enumerator_Release
function.description: This function releases the object enumerator and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is zero, it releases all the objects in the enumerator and frees the memory allocated for the objects and the enumerator itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IEnumUnknown interface of the object enumerator to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement operation.

function.name: object_enumerator_Next
function.description: This function enumerates over objects. It increments the position of the enumerator and adds a reference to the object at the current position. It continues this process until it has enumerated the specified count of objects or until it has enumerated all objects.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of unknown type

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of objects to enumerate

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an unknown type, used to return the enumerated objects

parameters.name: fetched
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG, used to return the number of objects actually enumerated

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the specified count of objects were enumerated, otherwise returns S_FALSE

function.name: object_enumerator_Skip
function.description: This function skips a certain number of elements in an enumeration of unknown objects.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the enumeration of unknown objects.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of elements to skip in the enumeration.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns S_FALSE.

function.name: object_enumerator_Reset
function.description: This function resets the position of the enumerator to 0.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IEnumUnknown interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful.

function.name: object_enumerator_Clone
function.description: This function clones an object enumerator, creating a new enumerator that contains the same enumeration state as the current one.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the object enumerator to be cloned.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that receives the interface pointer to the new enumerator.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If the 'ret' parameter is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. Otherwise, it returns the result of the 'create_object_enumerator' function.

function.name: create_object_enumerator
function.description: This function creates an object enumerator, initializes it, and assigns it to the 'ret' parameter. It also handles memory allocation and deallocation for the object enumerator.

parameters.name: objects
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of IUnknown pointers that the enumerator will enumerate.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The starting position in the 'objects' array for the enumeration.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of objects in the 'objects' array that the enumerator will enumerate.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumUnknown interface. The function assigns the address of the created enumerator to this parameter.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: metadata_block_reader_initialize
function.description: This function initializes a metadata block reader by setting its fields to the provided values and setting all other bytes to zero.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: A pointer to the metadata block reader to be initialized

parameters.name: decoder
parameters.description: A pointer to a common decoder object

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: An unsigned integer representing a frame

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: metadata_block_reader_cleanup
function.description: This function cleans up a metadata block reader by releasing all its metadata readers, freeing its readers and metadata blocks, and resetting its memory to zero.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: The metadata block reader to be cleaned up.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: metadata_block_reader_initialize_metadata
function.description: This function initializes the metadata for a given metadata block reader. It checks if the metadata is already initialized, if not, it locks the decoder, gets the metadata blocks, allocates memory for the readers, and handles any memory allocation failures.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the metadata block reader that needs to be initialized.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation for readers fails.

function.name: metadata_block_reader_get_container_format
function.description: This function retrieves the container format of a metadata block reader.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: Pointer to the metadata block reader whose container format is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID object where the container format will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, otherwise returns an error code.

function.name: metadata_block_reader_get_count
function.description: This function initializes the metadata of the block reader and sets the count to the metadata count of the block reader if the initialization is successful.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: A pointer to the block reader whose metadata is to be initialized and count is to be set.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer where the count of metadata of the block reader will be stored if the initialization is successful.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_INVALIDARG if the count pointer is NULL, otherwise returns the result of the metadata initialization operation.

function.name: metadata_block_reader_get_reader
function.description: This function retrieves a metadata reader from a metadata block reader at a specified index. If the metadata reader does not exist, it creates one.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: Pointer to the metadata block reader from which to retrieve the metadata reader.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index at which to retrieve the metadata reader.

parameters.name: ret_reader
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the metadata reader.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, E_INVALIDARG if the input arguments are invalid, or other error codes if the function fails.

function.name: metadata_block_reader_get_enumerator
function.description: This function initializes the metadata of a block reader, creates an array of unknown objects, gets a metadata reader for each object, creates an object enumerator, and releases the objects. It returns an HRESULT indicating the success or failure of these operations.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: A pointer to the block reader whose metadata is to be initialized and read

parameters.name: enumerator
parameters.description: A double pointer to an IEnumUnknown interface. The function sets this to point to the created object enumerator

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It can be S_OK for success, E_INVALIDARG if the enumerator argument is NULL, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or other error codes indicating failure of the metadata initialization or reader creation

function.name: impl_from_IWICBitmapDecoder
function.description: This function returns the CommonDecoder object that contains the given IWICBitmapDecoder interface

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IWICBitmapDecoder interface

function.return_type: CommonDecoder * - Pointer to CommonDecoder object that contains the given IWICBitmapDecoder interface

function.name: impl_decoder_from_IWICMetadataBlockReader
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a CommonDecoder structure from an IWICMetadataBlockReader interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICMetadataBlockReader interface

function.return_type: CommonDecoder *: Pointer to a CommonDecoder structure

function.name: CommonDecoder_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches the known interfaces, and if it does, it returns a pointer to the interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapDecoder interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to query

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer if the function is successful

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL, and E_NOINTERFACE if the provided interface ID does not match any known interfaces

function.name: CommonDecoder_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the CommonDecoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an IWICBitmapDecoder interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: CommonDecoder_Release
function.description: This function releases the resources associated with a CommonDecoder object. It decrements the reference count and if it reaches zero, it releases the associated stream, cleans up the metadata block reader, destroys the decoder and frees the memory allocated to the CommonDecoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapDecoder interface of the CommonDecoder object to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after decrementing. If the reference count reaches zero, the resources associated with the CommonDecoder object are released.

function.name: CommonDecoder_QueryCapability
function.description: This function queries the capability of a common decoder. It initializes the decoder and sets the capability based on the decoder's file info flags.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface of the bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is the stream to be decoded.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a DWORD where the capability of the decoder will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code. If either stream or capability is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG.

function.name: CommonDecoder_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a common decoder with a given interface, input stream, and cache options.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface for the bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: pIStream
parameters.description: This is the input stream for the decoder.

parameters.name: cacheOptions
parameters.description: This is the cache options for the decoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the decoder is already initialized, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE.

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetContainerFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the container format of a CommonDecoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapDecoder interface

parameters.name: pguidContainerFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID variable where the container format will be copied

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetDecoderInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the decoder information for a given bitmap decoder interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the bitmap decoder interface.

parameters.name: ppIDecoderInfo
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer that will receive the decoder information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns the result of the get_decoder_info function.

function.name: CommonDecoder_CopyPalette
function.description: This function copies the color palette from a decoder to a palette object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapDecoder interface that represents the decoder.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICPalette interface that represents the palette object to which the color palette will be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if the operation fails.

function.name: common_decoder_create_query_reader
function.description: This function creates a query reader from a block reader using a component factory.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for reading metadata blocks.

parameters.name: query_reader
parameters.description: Double pointer to an interface for reading metadata queries.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetMetadataQueryReader
function.description: This function retrieves a metadata query reader for a bitmap decoder. If the decoder does not support metadata, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapDecoder interface that represents the bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: reader
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IWICMetadataQueryReader interface. This parameter receives the metadata query reader.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the reader parameter is NULL, or WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION if the decoder does not support metadata.

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetPreview
function.description: This function checks if the bitmap source pointer is null, if it is, it returns an error. If not, it sets the bitmap source pointer to null and returns an unsupported operation error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the bitmap decoder interface

parameters.name: ppIBitmapSource
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the bitmap source

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows to represent error conditions, and warning conditions as well. The function returns E_INVALIDARG if ppIBitmapSource is null, otherwise it returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION.

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetColorContexts
function.description: This function is used to get color contexts from a common decoder. However, it currently returns an unsupported operation error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: An interface pointer to the bitmap decoder

parameters.name: cCount
parameters.description: The count of color contexts to get

parameters.name: ppIColorContexts
parameters.description: A pointer to the pointer of the color contexts to get

parameters.name: pcActualCount
parameters.description: A pointer to the actual count of color contexts gotten

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetThumbnail
function.description: This function is used to get the thumbnail from a common decoder. If the thumbnail is not available, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: ppIThumbnail
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the bitmap source for the thumbnail.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if ppIThumbnail is NULL, and WINCODEC_ERR_CODECNOTHUMBNAIL if the thumbnail is not available.

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetFrameCount
function.description: This function retrieves the frame count from a CommonDecoder object. If the object's stream is null, it sets the frame count to 0.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapDecoder interface from which the CommonDecoder object is retrieved

parameters.name: pCount
parameters.description: Pointer to a UINT variable where the frame count is stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_INVALIDARG if the pCount parameter is null

parameters.name: iface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier

parameters.name: ppv

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or an error code

function.name: CommonDecoder_Block_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to a CommonDecoder block.

parameters.name: iface

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count of the CommonDecoder block.

function.description: This function releases the block reader interface of a common decoder object.

parameters.name: iface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.description: This function retrieves a metadata reader from a metadata block reader by its index.

function.name: CommonDecoderFrame_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches any of the known interface IDs. If it does, it assigns the corresponding interface to the output parameter and increases its reference count. If it doesn't, it sets the output parameter to NULL and returns an error.

parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface of the object.

parameters.name: iid

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows operating systems, and the component object model (COM) to represent error conditions, and warning conditions. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE if not. It also returns E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL.

function.name: CommonDecoderFrame_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the CommonDecoderFrame object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.description: This function releases the resources associated with a CommonDecoderFrame object when its reference count reaches zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface of the CommonDecoderFrame object to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the CommonDecoderFrame object after it has been decremented.

function.name: CommonDecoderFrame_GetSize

parameters.name: puiWidth
parameters.description: Pointer to store the width of the decoded frame.

parameters.name: puiHeight
parameters.description: Pointer to store the height of the decoded frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, otherwise returns an error code.

function.description: This function gets the resolution of a common decoder frame.

parameters.name: pDpiY

function.name: CommonDecoderFrame_CopyPalette

parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to receive the bitmap data

parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the count of metadata blocks will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: CommonDecoder_GetFrame
function.description: This function retrieves a frame from a bitmap decoder, handling errors and managing memory as necessary.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap decoder interface from which to retrieve the frame.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the frame to retrieve.

parameters.name: ppIBitmapFrame
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a bitmap frame decode interface, which will be set to the retrieved frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and an error code otherwise.

function.name: CommonDecoder_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a common decoder, initializes it, and queries an interface on it.

parameters.name: decoder
parameters.description: Pointer to a decoder structure to be initialized

parameters.name: decoder_info
parameters.description: Pointer to a decoder_info structure that contains information about the decoder

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Interface identifier to be queried on the decoder

parameters.name: ppv
